# obot_git_credential (Resource)

Manages a Git credential: a token Obot uses to read private HTTPS Git sources on one host, such as catalog sources that set `git_credential_id`. Obot never returns the token. Set exactly one of `token`, which is stored in Terraform state, or `token_wo`, which is never stored and needs Terraform 1.11 or later. Obot refuses to delete a credential while a source uses it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "github_token" {
  description = "Token with read access to the private catalog repository."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  ephemeral   = true
}

resource "obot_git_credential" "github" {
  display_name = "GitHub catalogs"
  host         = "github.com"

  # Write-only: never stored in state. Increase the version to send a new token.
  token_wo         = var.github_token
  token_wo_version = 1
}

resource "obot_mcp_catalog_source" "private" {
  url               = "https://github.com/example/private-catalog"
  git_credential_id = obot_git_credential.github.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name. Names need not be unique.
- `host` (String) Git host the credential is used for, such as `github.com`, with an optional port. Sources must be on this host. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Token Obot sends as the HTTPS password, such as a GitHub personal access token. Stored in Terraform state; prefer `token_wo` with Terraform 1.11 or later. Changing it updates the stored token.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only token, never stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later and `token_wo_version`. Change `token_wo_version` to send a new token.
- `token_wo_version` (Number) Version of `token_wo`. Terraform cannot compare write-only values, so change this to send `token_wo` again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The generated Obot Git credential ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_git_credential.github
  identity = {
    id = "gc1example"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The generated Obot Git credential ID.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = obot_git_credential.github
  id = "gc1example"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import obot_git_credential.github gc1example
```
